plainTranslation: The Venus person's love meets Pluto's hunger for depth and control. Magnetic does not automatically mean healthy. The test is whether desire leaves both people freer and more honest, not more afraid.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Synced from authored synastry bundle synastry-authored__19_ (2).json.
summaryDeep: Their intensity and your affection make a charged, sometimes destabilizing pull. Jealousy or power can enter the love. Keep your autonomy inside the intensity.
tension: But pressure is not the same as love. When this aspect becomes unconscious, the relationship can start running on jealousy, testing, withdrawal, rupture, reunion, and emotional intensity. One person may try to regain power by pulling away. The other may chase harder. The connection can become addictive, not because it is healthy, but because the highs and lows keep activating the desire to be chosen. Pay attention to what this bond brings out in you. Do you feel more confident, more honest, and more connected to your own worth? Or do you feel consumed by the need to be wanted, reassured, or chosen?
advice: You do not have to call possession love. You do not have to stay in a painful cycle because the chemistry is strong. The wisdom of this aspect comes from learning the difference between desire that transforms you and desire that destabilizes you.
summaryShort: Their intensity and your affection make a charged, sometimes destabilizing pull.
